content.text:
## Summary

Admin management is separated from Settings. Admins get an **Admin** item at the end of the bottom nav; everyone else still sees the original six items.

## Files changed

| File | Change |
|------|--------|
| `src/components/Layout.tsx` | Appends **Admin** nav link only when `session.role === 'admin'` |
| `src/pages/Settings.tsx` | Removed **Administration** section and link to `/admin` |
| `src/pages/Admin.tsx` | Added **Rewards** and **Punishments** tabs with list + create/update + delete |
| `src/hooks/useAppStore.tsx` | `addReward` / `updateReward` / `deleteReward` and punishment-template CRUD |
| `src/types/index.ts` | `PunishmentTemplate` type; `punishmentTemplates` on `AppState` |
| `src/lib/seed.ts` | Default punishment templates in initial state (state version 3) |
| `src/lib/storage.ts` | Migrates missing `punishmentTemplates` from defaults |
| `src/lib/gameLogic.ts` | Quota-miss punishments use `state.punishmentTemplates` (not hardcoded seed) |
| `src/index.css` | `.tabs--scroll` for horizontal tab scrolling on small screens |

## Verification

- **Settings**: no `admin`, `Administration`, or “Open admin panel” references.
- **Layout**: Admin nav only when `session?.role === 'admin'`.

## Admin tabs

1. **Categories** — List categories; tap to edit; form to create/update; **Delete** (with confirm) removes category and its tasks.
2. **Tasks** — List tasks; tap to edit; form (title, category, level, XP, frequency, optional duration); **Delete** removes task and cleans daily plans.
3. **Rewards** — Catalog for the Rewards page: **Shop** (point cost) or **Badge** (auto-unlock by streak days or level); create/update/delete.
4. **Punishments** — Edits **templates** only (catalog applied on quota miss, up to 2/day). Active user punishments on `/punishments` are unchanged. Create/update/delete templates (title, description, points lost).
5. **Users** — Create user or admin accounts (unchanged).

**Settings** (all roles): daily quota, reset hour, change password, sign out, reset game data.
